import pandas as pd


def month_table(dates, stores, amounts):
    df = pd.DataFrame({"date": dates, "store": stores, "amount": amounts})
    df["month"] = pd.to_datetime(df["date"], format="%Y-%m-%d").dt.to_period("M").astype(str)
